injectedPorts: Existing UI tests inject scoped IO and command ports. Renderer suites use the actual Renderer layout/focus/overlay implementations. This standalone harness does not establish the productive sealed Maraca/React/Vue acceptance.

cases.name: all 36 UI imports are pure and export the exact managed-compatible shared class
every UI class mounts and releases without writing the Classic store or moving its host
input property updates are silent; input gestures deliver one normalized intent and reconnect releases listeners
radio changes never uncheck another managed or Classic instance
code, hero, masonry, menu and tabs preserve author element identity and attributes
managed dismissals request state transitions while retaining the host
writer sanitizes model HTML and delegates saving/export to the injected owner ports
managed Modal title stays text and cannot create executable or resource-bearing markup
Dialog dimensions reject stylesheet injection before the first write and preserve valid updates atomically
typed multiple selection and date constraints survive Model projection
controlled commands require a Model Action and never mutate the projected value themselves
Model-owned overlay open and checkbox checked remain authoritative after gestures
file DTOs contain scoped opaque handles; arbitrary File-like objects are rejected
sanitized modal HTML and declarative actions never execute callback fields

expectedAttackConsoleMessages.text: Executing inline event handler violates the following Content Security Policy directive 'script-src 'self' 'report-sample''. Either the 'unsafe-inline' keyword, a hash ('sha256-...'), or a nonce ('nonce-...') is required to enable inline execution. Note that hashes do not apply to event handlers, style attributes and javascript: navigations unless the 'unsafe-hashes' keyword is present. The action has been blocked.

cases.name: the actual renderer prepares before attributes, routes a single lexical intent and silently patches controlled props
Renderer-owned tabs project exact original children and restore authored visibility on release
Renderer-owned masonry reorders originals by typed keys and rejects foreign or missing refs atomically
lexical native On conditions read the live Model and cannot fall through a Surface delegate
owned Hero scroll and Menu keyboard navigation use real Renderer ports
owned Tooltip anchor leases preserve other descriptions and release callbacks on Suspend
actual modal leases inert only owned app siblings, trap focus, track Model changes and release on Suspend
conditional Tooltip anchors retire their listeners and rebind the same ref to its new owned lifetime
the demo remains an actual Classic CSR lifecycle and author-slot reference, not a productive native grant
all six platform tags bind to actual Controller/Graph and command fibers rather than local managers
real platform UI flags project false to true to false without changing Controller authority
all six released platform bindings stay revoked after Suspend and a fresh activation
Surface platform gestures commit bounds and state through the real graph and preserve foreign records
a genuine component-command Effect invokes the actual scoped platform handler inside its exact Kernel job
close, minimize and collapse return only genuine Controller receipts after their own scope deactivation
native Router delegates the captured local destination to the injected History host and publishes its Model intent
Portal projection retains the exact declared existing Portal and rejects policy replacement
forged authority-valued platform attributes and route data fail before managed host mutation
pure native imports do not bootstrap globals, CE registration, listeners or i18n patches
managed State reuses the existing adapter with isolated keys and owned cleanup
managed i18n labels stay data, preserve Light DOM and reject foreign roots
scoped Theme uses the shared manager, restores owned values and preserves host writes
borrowed services are not disposed, missing transition/platform capabilities fail
owned Utils effects complete through the actual transition Renderer port and disposal revokes held or late work
managed Surface region delegates to the real controller and releases once without ancestor writes
